per-mărīnus , a, um, adj.,
I.that accompanies through the sea: “Lares,” marine Lares, guardian deities of those who travel by sea, Liv. 40, 52, 7 (gen. plur. permarinūm); M. Aurel. ap. Front. Ep. 3, 9; cf.: permarini, διαπόντιοι, Gloss. Philox.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
